# sdlrealtor.com

> Premium exact-match domain for sale. Not an operating real estate brokerage.

sdlrealtor.com is available for acquisition from SDL Domains in Scottsdale, Arizona.

- Contact: sales@desertrich.com
- Offer page: https://sdlrealtor.com/acquire/
- Why the name: https://sdlrealtor.com/scottsdale-realtor-domain/
- Buyer FAQ: https://sdlrealtor.com/faq/
- Homepage: https://sdlrealtor.com/

SDL is the identifier for Scottsdale Airport (KSDL) and a local abbreviation for Scottsdale. The second label is “realtor.” The domain is 11 letters, no hyphen, .com.

Sale terms: price on request, confidential inquiry, escrow (Escrow.com or equivalent), then registrar transfer. The sale is the domain name only. It does not include a license, leads, a website, trademark rights, or guaranteed search rankings. REALTOR® is a trademark of the National Association of REALTORS®. SDL Domains is not affiliated with NAR.

Typical response time: 24–48 hours.
